# Masimera

> Masimera is a free website for learning Greek and Italian by reading the local news. Every morning it publishes one short lesson per language: a real local news story, rewritten in simple language, with audio, 20 to 30 key words translated into English and French, example sentences and a 10-word quiz. It takes about 15 minutes a day and keeps you informed about local life.

Site: https://masimera.com/
Languages taught: Greek (Modern Greek) and Italian. Explanations in English, word translations in English and French.
Price: free. A new lesson is published every morning (Greek and Italian), with an optional daily email.

## Method
- About 3,000 words cover around 96% of everyday conversation, roughly level B1 (Nation 2006).
- Lessons train three things: words, sentence structure, and guessing the rest from context.
- Every lesson has audio, because recognizing a word when you hear it is a skill of its own.
- Details and sources: https://masimera.com/method.html

## Main pages
- [Greek of the day](https://masimera.com/grec/): all Greek lessons, newest first
- [Italian of the day](https://masimera.com/it/): all Italian lessons, newest first
- [Greek vocabulary](https://masimera.com/grec/mots.html): every Greek word from the lessons, in English and French, with example sentences and audio
- [Italian vocabulary](https://masimera.com/it/mots.html): every Italian word from the lessons, in English and French, with example sentences and audio
- [The Masimera method](https://masimera.com/method.html): how many words you need and why 15 minutes a day works
